description:
Save a script on a computer as a named tool, so it can be used again later with computer_use_tool (by you, or in a later conversation or automation).

WHEN TO USE:
- You worked out a multi-step job that will be needed again (a weekly report, a file clean-up, a site check). Test it with computer_run first, then save it.

GOOD TO KNOW: the script is bash (or anything with a #! line); arguments arrive as $1, $2…; it runs in the home folder. Saving with an existing name replaces that tool.

RETURNS: the tool's name and where it is saved (~/tools/<name>).

computer.description: The computer's name, as computer_list shows it (for example "research").

description.description: One or two sentences: what it does and what arguments it takes.

name.description: Tool name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes (for example "weekly-report").

name: computer_save_tool
